fees: $35 for one artwork entry, $10 for up to one additional artwork. PAC Members eligible for $10 off initial fee; Students eligible for $15 off initial fee.
maxSize: 3D works may not be heavier than 100 lbs; no firm size limit for other work, but space is limited.
mediums: Any media (excluding reproductions of original artworks and AI-generated works)
framing: Hanging apparatus must be secured; 2D works must be securely wired with D-Rings.
location: Providence Art Club, 11 Thomas Street, Providence, RI 02903
